nl.bodyHtml:
AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) optimaliseert content zodat antwoordengines en AI-systemen jouw antwoorden betrouwbaar kunnen gebruiken — naast klassieke zoekresultaten.

Bij TripleZero iT betekent AEO o.a. antwoordklare content, FAQ’s, entity-clarity en structured data, in samenhang met SEO en GEO. Dienstpagina: /diensten/aeo-optimization.

Heb je na het volgen van deze stappen nog vragen? Neem contact op met TripleZero iT support via het ticketssysteem of e-mail. Vermeld altijd je domeinnaam en een duidelijke omschrijving van het probleem, zodat we sneller kunnen helpen.

Bekijk ook andere artikelen in de kennisbank voor aanvullende uitleg over hosting, e-mail en beveiliging.

en.title: What is AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)?
en.excerpt: What is AEO (Answer Engine Optimization): prepare, execute, verify — with facts and one change at a time.
en.bodyHtml:
For “What is AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)” first gather facts (where it happens, error text, last change). Then take one targeted action and verify the result.

Preparation

  • Where does it happen? (VPS, hosting panel, DNS, CMS, mail, client panel)
  • Exact error text, status or symptom
  • Backup/snapshot if you change something structural

Steps

  1. Write in one sentence the desired end state of “What is AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)”.
  2. Note current state (screenshot, version, record, log line).
  3. Apply one targeted change in the system that owns that state.
  4. Save / restart only what is needed.
  5. Verify with an external test or second browser/network; record what changed.

Verify

  • End state reached or explained why not
  • No unintended regression on a critical flow

Tip: Tickets: domain, timestamp, error text, what you already tried.

Note: No destructive deletes without a restore point.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: Backups, monitoring, support.
